definitions.explanation: Large crystals of pure sugar, clear or white, used especially in making fruit liqueurs, preserved fruits, and traditional sweets. Dissolves slowly, making it ideal for infusions.

examples.japanese: {氷砂糖|こおりざとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I make plum wine with rock sugar.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{氷砂糖|こおりざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べていた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I used to eat rock sugar as a snack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{青梅|あおうめ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同量|どうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{氷砂糖|こおりざとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To make plum syrup, you need the same amount of rock sugar as green plums.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧ (ice) and ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar). Named for its ice-like transparent crystal appearance. Essential in Japanese home cooking for making ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧ (plum wine) and ⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧ (plum syrup), which are popular summer preparations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {氷砂糖|こおりざとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧: to preserve/infuse with rock sugar
- {氷砂糖|こおりざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧: to dissolve rock sugar
- ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{氷砂糖|こおりざとう}: rock sugar for plum wine

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {氷砂糖|こおりざとう} is most strongly associated with making ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧ and ⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧ at home in June, during the plum harvest season. It is preferred over regular sugar because it dissolves slowly, gradually drawing out the plum flavor without making the liquid overly sweet too quickly.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上白糖|じょうはくとう}→上白糖：25163_jouhakutou⟧: refined white sugar — the standard granulated sugar used in Japan
- ⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧: granulated sugar — coarser crystals, common in baking
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown sugar, muscovado — unrefined, with a deep molasses flavor
